crossrefs.text: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation; deliver me from deceitful and unjust men.
Defend my cause and redeem me; revive me according to Your word.
Therefore this is what the LORD says: “Behold, I will plead your case and take vengeance on your behalf; I will dry up her sea and make her springs run dry.

Indeed, this is what the LORD says: “Even the captives of the mighty will be taken away, and the plunder of the tyrant will be retrieved; I will contend with those who contend with you, and I will save your children.
for their Redeemer is strong; He will take up their case against you.
You defend my cause, O Lord; You redeem my life.
for the LORD will take up their case and will plunder those who rob them.
He caused their chariot wheels to wobble, so that they had difficulty driving. “Let us flee from the Israelites,” said the Egyptians, “for the LORD is fighting for them against Egypt!”
Who among the gods is like You, O LORD? Who is like You—majestic in holiness, revered with praises, performing wonders?
I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy.
Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones You have crushed rejoice.
Your righteousness reaches to the heavens, O God, You who have done great things. Who, O God, is like You?
O Lord, there is none like You among the gods, nor any works like Yours.
For He stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save him from the condemners of his soul.

I will rejoice greatly in the LORD, my soul will exult in my God; for He has clothed me with garments of salvation and wrapped me in a robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom wears a priestly headdress, as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
At that time Hannah prayed: “My heart rejoices in the LORD in whom my horn is exalted. My mouth speaks boldly against my enemies, for I rejoice in Your salvation.
I wept and fasted, but it brought me reproach.
I made sackcloth my clothing, and I was sport to them.
But Jesus responded, “I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these do you stone Me?”
Do not hand me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.
Those who repay my good with evil attack me for pursuing the good.
Should good be repaid with evil? Yet they have dug a pit for me. Remember how I stood before You to speak good on their behalf, to turn Your wrath from them.
Have I not wept for those in trouble? Has my soul not grieved for the needy?
His anger has torn me and opposed me; He gnashes His teeth at me. My adversary pierces me with His eyes.

Your eyes are too pure to look upon evil, and You cannot tolerate wrongdoing. So why do You tolerate the faithless? Why are You silent while the wicked swallow up those more righteous than themselves?
My soul is deeply distressed. How long, O LORD, how long?
But You have regarded trouble and grief; You see to repay it by Your hand. The victim entrusts himself to You; You are the helper of the fatherless.
How long, O LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me? How long must I wrestle in my soul, with sorrow in my heart each day? How long will my enemy dominate me?
Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of wild dogs. Save me from the mouth of the lion; at the horns of the wild oxen You have answered me!

I will proclaim Your name to my brothers; I will praise You in the assembly. You who fear the LORD, praise Him! All descendants of Jacob, honor Him! All offspring of Israel, revere Him! For He has not despised or detested the torment of the afflicted. He has not hidden His face from him, but has attended to his cry for help. My praise for You resounds in the great assembly; I will fulfill my vows before those who fear You.
They will come and proclaim His righteousness to a people yet unborn— all that He has done.

I proclaim righteousness in the great assembly; behold, I do not seal my lips, as You, O LORD, do know. I have not covered up Your righteousness in my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and salvation; I have not concealed Your loving devotion and faithfulness from the great assembly.
I will make an everlasting covenant with them: I will never turn away from doing good to them, and I will put My fear in their hearts, so that they will never turn away from Me.
Yes, I will rejoice in doing them good, and I will faithfully plant them in this land with all My heart and with all My soul.
For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He adorns the afflicted with salvation.
May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “The LORD be magnified!”
The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.”
Those who hate me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head; many are those who would destroy me— my enemies for no reason. Though I did not steal, I must repay.
May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “Let God be magnified!”
With me are riches and honor, enduring wealth and righteousness.

notes.title: They hated me without a cause
